specialistReviews.finding: Even INSERT+UPDATE trigger guards may be bypassed by DB owner disabling triggers or forged caller-controlled actor/template fields; no live role tests have been run.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep source-only status, require disposable Postgres direct INSERT/UPDATE negative tests, effective grants, actor/session authentication and trigger disable threat review before any release.

specialistReviews.finding: An unconditional UPDATE recheck may reject invalid legacy jobs on status change, but fail-closed behavior is preferable to unsafe delivery and must be reconciled operationally.
specialistReviews.resolution: Do not run live; require read-only existing queued-job inventory and explicit approved remediation/rollback plan first.

specialistReviews.finding: Custom high-risk forward-only schema trigger replacement requires its own 5/5 release unit.
specialistReviews.resolution: Only 0060 SQL, manifest, neutral regressions, exact prior head and canonical history unchanged.

specialistReviews.finding: Existing mailbox disabled between queue and dispatch could cause fail-closed UPDATE on claim/status paths.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require operational integration/queue lifecycle tests on disposable Postgres and occupied data read-only preflight before rollout.

challenge.scenario: An existing support_reply Office job has a valid route at initial INSERT, then mailbox is disabled before its next status UPDATE.
challenge.finding: The old INSERT-only trigger permits state change even though sender mailbox is no longer active.
challenge.resolution: Replace trigger to run BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE and reevaluate active mailbox/route from NEW row.

challenge.scenario: An untagged communication job becomes support_reply and gets officeThreadId through an UPDATE.
challenge.finding: Original source runs INSERT only so the new Office tag bypasses mailbox and route validation.
challenge.resolution: Use BEFORE UPDATE in canonical helper trigger for all row modifications.

challenge.scenario: A tagged Office job changes instance_id to an unrelated organization after being queued.
challenge.finding: A forged tenant identity might redirect or misattribute customer communication.
challenge.resolution: Immutability guard rejects instance_id change once original row was Office support_reply.

challenge.scenario: A tagged Office job changes its officeThreadId to another customer thread in the same tenant.
challenge.finding: The job could be reassigned to a different buyer thread without audited requeue approval.
challenge.resolution: Immutability guard requires identical old and new officeThreadId for any UPDATE.

challenge.scenario: A tagged Office reply job removes officeThreadId or rewrites template_key before worker claims it.
challenge.finding: The normal canonical validator then short-circuits and skips mailbox/route checks entirely.
challenge.resolution: Reject removing Office tag or changing support_reply template after initial Office-bound INSERT.

challenge.scenario: A routine status-only UPDATE occurs on a valid Office job while mailbox and route remain active.
challenge.finding: Overly broad immutable field checks might reject legitimate communication job state progression.
challenge.resolution: Compare only tenant/thread/template routing context; permit unchanged context and canonical mailbox revalidation.

challenge.scenario: A non-Office transactional email job updates status or retries delivery.
challenge.finding: A global new trigger may erroneously require Office mailbox for all communication jobs.
challenge.resolution: Canonical trigger early-return applies to non-support or absent-office-tag rows; immutability guard only activates for OLD tagged Office reply.

challenge.scenario: A privileged service_role or table owner disables triggers before updating a job.
challenge.finding: Source trigger code cannot guarantee runtime protection against SQL role/ownership bypass.
challenge.resolution: Demand real pg_trigger enabled/state, effective grants, privileged worker behavior and target role tests before claiming closure.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Security gap found during U10A2 F11 source audit: original 20260908034500 queue trigger only fires BEFORE INSERT. An existing service_role communication_jobs row can be changed via UPDATE so its payload/template_key/instance_id points to an Office reply thread without revalidating active mailbox and private routing token, and existing Office-bound rows may be relabeled or switched to another tenant. Preserve canonical 0058 in history; add a separate forward-only 0060 SQL to reinstall mailbox guard for both INSERT and UPDATE and reject changing or removing Office reply routing context after initial insertion. Do not run on occupied staging or claim live proof.
observableOutcomes: Append custom forward-only 0060 after canonical 0059; earlier 0001–0059 SQL byte identity untouched.

Existing private.enforce_office_reply_queue_mailbox_v1() trigger is reattached BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE, so any queue row modifications revalidate current customer-only thread, tenant, active mailbox and secret route.
New SECURITY INVOKER private Office reply context immutability trigger rejects UPDATE changing instance_id, template_key or removing/changing officeThreadId on an already tagged support_reply job.
Canonical F11 mail-routing SQL is not modified; F13 source has clear security audit provenance and no false upstream source hash.
